C1289.title: Helibao Fined and Confiscated About RMB 74.88 Million for Clearing and Merchant Management Violations
C1289.summary: On December 31, 2025, the Guangdong Branch of the People's Bank of China disclosed penalty decisions No. 52 and 53 of 2025. Guangzhou Helibao Payment Technology was penalized for violations involving clearing, payment acceptance terminals, merchant management, and account management. Illegal gains of RMB 12.0802 million were confiscated and a RMB 62.7997 million fine was imposed, totaling RMB 74.8799 million; responsible person Zhao was separately fined RMB 925,000.
